check_key_in_limits: check if a request is within rate limits for a key, model, user, team, or customer
async_pre_call_hook: run parallel request and rate limit checks before an API call is executed
async_log_success_event: update usage counters in cache after a successful API call completes
async_log_failure_event: decrement usage counters in cache after a failed API call
async_post_call_success_hook: add rate limit headers to the response after a successful API call
